_doc: Street dressing (story 16.9, AD-31). Densities are per mille of the eligible tiles (render/streetMath.js decides which tiles are eligible from the neighbours: a facade to the north for planters, bins and bikes, a road beside the tile for bollards, hydrants and signs, a fence beside it for letterboxes); `weeds` and `leaves` are the chance per kerb side. `schoolyard`: the open concrete within rx tiles of the school door and ry tiles in front of it carries the playground markings and chalk drawings. Standing props are images lent from a fixed pool (the tier's `streetProps` in quality.json) to what is near the view; the pool is made at map load, so the display list does not grow while playing. `margin`: base pixels around the view where props show. `depth` of the kiosk awning part is the prop's own foot line.
